svg.title: SME Procurement-Preparation Agent - bounded agent architecture
svg.desc: One bounded loop per flagged reorder item: Sense/Context, Plan/Decide, Policy gate, Act/Tool, Observe, then an outcome classifier that advances, re-plans, hands off to the Procurement Officer or stops. Panels list the per-phase allow-list, limits, and stop and hand-off conditions.
svg.text: Week 5 agent architecture - one bounded loop per flagged item: sense, plan, gate, act, observe, then advance, re-plan, hand off or stop
Bounded agent loop (orchestrator owns order, limits and stop reason)
function call over the current allow-list; policy and draft steps
PROGRESS: advance phase, save checkpoint, next iteration
An officer who declines at a hand-off ends the run with stop reason OFFICER_DECLINED; the item is left for manual handling.
Approved next actions by phase (per-phase allow-list)
The planner is offered only the actions in its current row. Anything else is refused as TOOL_NOT_ALLOWED before it runs.
runs only after the officer confirms
Every phase also allows hand_off and stop. After the officer clears a NAME_DISCREPANCY or supplies an
exchange rate, the loop may re-run the read-only check that the change invalidated. retrieve_policy and
draft_justification are AI-layer steps, not catalogue tools, so the charter's four-tool ceiling still holds.
Proposed; fixed in the Agent Task Contract.
is not counted; the clock pauses.
A second failure of the same kind is
Same action with the same arguments
twice in a row stops with NO_PROGRESS.
Model retries stay inside one iteration.
Outcome classes: stop, hand-off and re-plan conditions
DRAFT_CREATED: requisition held in DRAFT for the officer to submit.
invalid_input from proposed arguments · first guard suppression
in a draft · rate-limited model call after client retries
(POL-001-C04 exception reason) · no eligible offer · EXCHANGE_RATE_
REQUIRED · citation withheld or no clause found · Gates 2 and 3 ·
TERMINAL: stop, state kept for retry (Req 7.5, 8.5, 9.4)
Policy Corpus unavailable · tool output fails its schema
After the loop (outside the agent's control)
approve or reject, purchase order, supplier contact, payment or
Solid arrows: control flow. Purple dashed: model call. Green: progress. Violet dashed: re-plan. Amber: human hand-off and resume. Red: stop.
Limits and stop conditions are proposals, to be confirmed in docs/requirements/agent-task-contract.md.
